# Greatstone International

> A digital transformation partner, not a software house. We embed alongside your team, find the hours your business is quietly losing, and build the systems that win them back. Twenty years of doing the work, with AI as the accelerator.

## What we do

Greatstone modernises how organisations actually work: their tools, their processes, their people, and the intelligent layer above them all. Every engagement begins with the Digital Transformation Playbook, a scored diagnostic across eight pillars that produces a clear read on where you stand and a phased roadmap to where you are going. We do not advise from the outside; we become the foundation you build the next decades on.

## The offer

- Deep Dive: a focused 30-minute session where we map your week against the eight pillars and show you where the hours are draining. No deck, no obligation, and the first step costs nothing.
- Build and embed: we find the drains, build the fix, then stay embedded until the new way is the only way. Usually weeks, not quarters.
- Software catalogue: hand-picked developer software (document, PDF, OCR, reporting and UI tools) from the vendors who make them best, licensed and supported in the UK.

## Key pages

- Home: the foundation of digital excellence.

- Services: how an engagement runs, from finding the drains to embedding the fix.
- Industries: the same foundation, shaped to the way your sector actually works.
- Proof: anonymised results, hours returned, and first-year ROI.
- Intelligence: a standing AI briefing, every meaningful move with Greatstone's own read on what it means for a business modernising with AI.
- Climb: the maturity model, from pebble to plateau to peak.
- About: twenty years embedded, not advisory.
- Contact: book a Deep Dive.
